parameters.name: selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling price of product p in period t

parameters.name: production_cost
parameters.description: Unit variable processing cost of product p in period t

parameters.name: material_requirements
parameters.description: Amount of raw material r required per unit of product p

parameters.name: purchase_cost
parameters.description: Unit purchase cost of raw material r in period t

parameters.name: purchase_limit
parameters.description: Maximum purchasable amount of raw material r in period t

parameters.name: resource_usage
parameters.description: Amount of restricted resource k consumed per unit of product p

parameters.name: resource_capacity
parameters.description: Available capacity of restricted resource k in period t

parameters.name: demand_limit
parameters.description: Maximum sellable quantity of product p in period t; may be infinite when demand is unlimited

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product p produced in period t

variables.name: sales_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product p sold in period t

variables.name: raw_material_purchase
variables.description: Quantity of raw material r purchased in period t

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit over the planning horizon

constraints.name: raw_material_purchase_limit
constraints.description: raw material purchases must stay within the per-period purchase limit for each raw material

constraints.name: production_material_support
constraints.description: production of each product must be supportable by purchased raw materials according to the recipe requirements

constraints.name: restricted_resource_capacity
constraints.description: production-induced consumption of each restricted resource must not exceed the available period capacity

constraints.name: sales_cannot_exceed_production
constraints.description: sales of each product in each period cannot exceed produced quantity

constraints.name: sales_cannot_exceed_demand
constraints.description: if demand is finite, sales of each product in each period cannot exceed the demand limit
constraints.formula: y_{p,t} \leq D_{p,t} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\ \forall t=1,\dots,T \text{ such that } D_{p,t}<+\infty

constraints.name: nonnegative_decision_quantities
constraints.description: all decision quantities must be nonnegative
constraints.formula: x_{p,t} \geq 0,\ y_{p,t} \geq 0,\ u_{r,t} \geq 0 \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\ \forall r=1,\dots,R,\ \forall t=1,\dots,T

constraints.name: purchase_material_balance
constraints.description: raw material purchases must be sufficient to support production of all products using the fixed recipes in each period

constraints.name: sales_upper_bound_finite_demand
constraints.description: if demand is finite, sales of each product in each period cannot exceed the demand limit
constraints.formula: y_{p,t} \leq D_{p,t} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\ \forall t=1,\dots,T\ \text{ with }\ D_{p,t}<+\infty

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: maximize total profit over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: maximize total profit over the planning horizon, defined as total sales revenue minus raw material purchasing costs and variable production costs
